newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon keeps hold on Axa.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon keeps hold on Axa.

text.p: Salomon brothers on Monday said it was maintaining its hold recommendation on French insurance group Axa-UAP following the company's 1996 results.
"We have not significantly changed our earnings estimates for the combined group," Salomon said in a note after the group's first annual results since last November's merger announcement.
Axa's net earnings of 3.8 billion francs were ahead of Salomon's forecast, but UAP's results were lower than expected.
"We have raised our Axa standalone estimates, but this has been largely offset by a reduced standalone UAP forecast."
Little new information came from the results, the broker said, adding that integrating the newly merged group will take some time.
Salomon said it had revised down its net asset value (NAV) estimate for the Axa-UAP to 307 francs from 336. However, it is maintaining its price target at 390 francs.
Axa shares were earlier trading at 365.6.
